items.title: Israel launches fresh strikes on Lebanon despite Trump criticism
items.description: Speaking on Tuesday, Trump said Israel's PM Benjamin Netanyahu needed "to be more responsible with respect to Lebanon".

items.title: Status quo at Jerusalem's holiest site under threat as Israeli nationalists flout rules
items.description: Israeli nationalists are increasingly flouting a convention on how faiths share the al-Aqsa mosque compound.

items.title: 'They came with machetes' - deadline looms for migrants to leave South Africa
items.description: Protesters have set 30 June as the date for all undocumented migrants to leave the country.

items.title: Search for six-year-old Ebola patient after armed men storm DR Congo hospital
items.description: Health facilities have come under attack during the current outbreak as a result of misinformation and fear.

items.title: Group planned to attack White House UFC event using snipers and drones, FBI says
items.description: In newly unsealed court filings, the government says the group allegedly expressed grievances about corruption, the Epstein files, and data centres.

items.title: Norway's crown princess undergoes successful lung transplant, palace says
items.description: Crown Princess Mette-Marit, who suffered from pulmonary fibrosis, will now spend several weeks recovering in hospital.

items.title: Iran sends tankers loaded with oil past US military blockade
items.description: Three Iranian tankers loaded with crude oil have passed the US blockade line in the Gulf of Oman, ship-tracking data shows.
